curve_equation_G1: y^2 = x^3 + 4 over Fp; G1=<P0> of order r
curve_equation_G2: y^2 = x^3 + 4*(1+u) over Fp2; G2=<Q0> of order r
field_Fp12: Fp[w]/(w^12-2*w^6+2); coefficient list [c0,...,c11] means sum(ci*w^i); u maps to w^6-1
group_GT: Nonzero z in Fp12 with z^r=1; identity [1,0,...,0]

pairing.definition: Reduced pairing e(P,Q)=py_ecc.optimized_bls12_381.pairing(Q,P,final_exponentiate=True) at the pinned commit. The library takes G2 first.

challenge: Sample x uniformly from 0..r-1 by rejection sampling; give only T=[x]P0. Recover x. Neither x nor its sampling coins are given. No auxiliary powers are supplied. This samples uniform G1, including infinity.
acceptance: Decode T and the returned scalar canonically; require T on the G1 curve and [r]T=infinity, and 0<=x<r. Accept exactly when [x]P0=T. The scalar 0 is valid exactly when T=infinity. Returning a point, a relation or a field-group element is not scalar recovery.
encoding: UTF-8 JSON with exactly the stated input or output keys. Each Fp coefficient is 96 lowercase hex characters, no prefix, representing an integer less than p. A G1 point is null for infinity or {x,y} with Fp coefficients. The scalar is 64 lowercase hex characters representing an integer less than r. Reject duplicate keys, noncanonical encodings, off-curve points and points outside G1.
